verdict.rationale: Foreloop's pipeline shows an agent reading a feedback submission and turning it into an 'intention' with proposed tasks (foreloop-docs-12), and users can start from vague feedback text like 'Users can't tell which invoices are overdue' (foreloop-docs-4). However, there's no explicit evidence of aggregating/decluttering multiple raw feedback items or ranking them by impact—only single-report-to-task conversion is documented.
